from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyHousingStart(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly housing start data point extracted from a report."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month of the housing start data, formatted YYYY-MM")
    saar_value: float | None = Field(description="The Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) for housing starts")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report was issued, used to determine precedence when values conflict across reports")
    series_label: str | None = Field(description="The scope of the housing data reported, e.g. 'Total' or 'Privately-Owned'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level container for extracted data from one document."""
    housing_start_records: list[MonthlyHousingStart]
